modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On November 4, 2008: Barack Obama (pictured) became the first person of biracial or African-American descent to be elected President of the United States.

image_credit.author: Official White House Photo by Pete Souza

did_you_know.fact: On November 4, 1973: The Netherlands experiences the first car-free Sunday caused by the 1973 oil crisis. Highways are used only by cyclists and roller skaters.
On November 4, 1847: Sir James Young Simpson, a Scottish medical doctor, discovers the anaesthetic properties of chloroform.
On November 4, 1737: The Teatro di San Carlo, the oldest working opera house in Europe, is inaugurated in Naples, Italy.
November 4 is observed as Unity Day (Russia).
